full_judgment: 2. Short facts relating for disposal of this appeal are that, the original owner of schedule to the plaint land were Mohontara Debi, Promoda Bala Debi and Sudhir Ranjan Nath who sold the suit land to Lal Miah, Chand Miah and Younus Miah by registered deed No. 567 dated 28-1-1951. Lal Miah and his other three brothers purchased 80 decimals of land of RS khatian No. 153 by kabala deed No. 566 on 21-1-1951. Lal Miah died leaving three brothers, Younus Miah, Chand Miah and Kala Miah and 2 sisters, Safia Khatun and Samana Khatun to inherit his share in the suit property. Wife, sons and daughters of Lal Miah died in a road accident in 1966. After the death of Lal Miah, Younus Miah and Chand Miah amicably partitioned the suit land of RS khatian No. 519 and while they were in possession their respective shares were sold, 0.0750 decimals of land by kabala deed Nos. 5286 and 5359 dated 14-3-1983 and 15-3-1983 to Abul Kalam Chowdhury and possession was delivered. Later on, Younus Miah by kabala deed No. 2545 dated 28-8-1983 sold 0.05 decimals of land from RS dag No. 519 to Habibur Rahman. Abul Kalam Chowdhury and Habibur Rahman mutated their names and open PS khatian No. 209 in their names. Abul Kalam Chowdhury by kabala deed No. 6080 dated 24-4-1989 sold 0.025 decimals of land from RS dag No. 519 and Habibur Rahman also sold similar quantum of land from same dag by kabala deed No. 603 dated 25-6-1989 to plaintiff No. 2 and delivered possession. Abul Kalam Chowdhury sold 0.0250 decimals of land to plaintiff No. 1, sold similar quantum of land by kabala deed No. 1800 dated 06-5-1989 to plaintiff No. 3, similar quantum of land from same dag by kabala No. 602 dated 06-8-1989 and delivered possession. Habibur Rahman also sold similar quantum of land from same dag to plaintiff No. 3 by kabala deed No. 603 dated 24-6-1989. In this way plaintiffs by 5 registered deeds purchased 1250 decimals of land from R.S. dag No. 519 and became owner and possessor and constructed pucca boundary wall, possessing the suit land having their title there to, they mutated their names and opened PS khatian No. 209/10 and paying rents regularly. In the aforesaid 5 purchase deeds, PS Khatian having been rightly recorded, they sold the purchased land to Abul Kalam Chowdhury and Habibur Rahman on 27-12-1989 and by correction deed No. 1765 corrected the same. Defend-ant No. 2 on 04-4-1995 published auction notice through "Daily Azadi" in respect of schedule No B to the suit land which was published pursuant to Mortgage Execution Case No. 27 of 1998. On query plaintiffs could know that defendant falsely showing Khorgled Miah, son of Lal Miah, Kashem Miah, son of Chand Miah and Mohammad Hossain, son of Younus Miah as owners, mortgaged the land of plaintiff to defendant No. 1 Bank. Bank by instituting Artha Rin Case No. 35 of 1995 got ex-parte decree and published notice. Lal Miah had no son named Khorshed Miah and Younus Miah had no son named Mohammad Hossain and there was no person in the name of defendant Nos. 4, 5 and 6 in the suit land and the aforesaid fictitious person earlier also committed similar type of activities.
